qualifications_or_emphasis: Impairment on investments/advances to subsidiaries: Management is hopeful of recovery and generating future income. Impairment will be considered when required.
Impairment on intangible assets: Management is hopeful of monetizing these assets across different avenues and hence impairment is not considered necessary at this stage.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: The company has not carried out an impairment assessment of its intangible assets during the year, although indicators of impairment were present. In our opinion, this constitutes non-compliance with the requirements of Accounting Standard [Ind AS 36], and accordingly, the carrying amount of intangible assets may be overstated to that extent.
Except for the possible effects of the matter described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion section above, proper books of account as required by law have been kept by the Company.

Except for the effects of the matter described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph above, the aforesaid Standalone financial statements complied with Indian Accounting Standards prescribed under Section 133 of the Act.

The Group has not recognized any impairment on intangible assets with a carrying amount of Rs.21,88,73,854 as at 31st March 2026 as required by Ind AS 36. Indicators of impairment exist, and the recoverable amount of these assets is likely to be lower than their carrying amount. The auditor is unable to determine whether any adjustment to intangible assets was necessary.

outlook.statement: The next 5/6 years promise a steady stream of income from the joint development deal with K. Raheja Corp Real Estate P. Ltd.
It is extremely difficult to forecast any profit numbers.
Post approvals, the Residential-Cum-Retail project 'Antares' commenced in late November, 2024.

The joint development project with KRC REPL will see completion by November 2029. The company will continue to make strategic investments in land & building and projects with growth potential. The next 3-4 years will be of great significance for pushing progress to advantage of all stakeholders.
Planning to launch Kannada and Malayalam YouTube channels to add to existing bouquet of channels.
There are some things in the pipeline being worked on with intense fervour & zest; will share with shareholders once total clarity is achieved.

Residential project 'Antares' (Towers A & B) under JV with K. Raheja launched in FY 2024-25, construction in full swing, expected completion by November 2029 per RERA; company expects substantial revenue to wipe off old losses and make company profitable.
Company continues to develop plots of land in 'Girivan' to enter hospitality industry.

Company exploiting existing intangible assets (digital entertainment content) via YouTube channels (Cinevista Entertainment, Cinevista Swift & Fast, Regional content channels); expects substantial revenues in coming years.
Group expects substantial revenue which will wipe off old losses and make the Group profitable from the Residential project 'Antares' expected to be completed by November 2029.
The Group expects to generate substantial revenues in the years to come from exploitation of intangible assets on YouTube channels.
The Girivan project will help the Group to enter into hospitality industry.
